title: Built a reversal indicator for XAUUSD — sharing results (1m/5m/15m)
author: Relative-Swing-8819
selftext:
*Been testing this indicator I built for catching top/bottom reversals on Gold (XAUUSD). Works across 1m, 5m, and 15m timeframes. Sharing some screenshots below — open to feedback. DM if interested in trying it out.*

comments.body: "It's a paid indicator, ₹999 lifetime access — happy to share a live demo first if interested."

replies.author: Bryanadamz
replies.body: If this is based on taking reversals if price moves outside a Deviation line like Bollinger or keltner, it does not work, ive tested it every way you can imagine and its not profitable long term

replies.author: Relative-Swing-8819
replies.body: You're right that plain Bollinger/Keltner mean-reversion alone isn't profitable long-term — I backtested the base version and got a profit factor under 1.0, confirms what you're saying. Added an ADX-based trend filter (only fires signals in ranging conditions, skips trending moves) plus ATR-based SL/TP. That got profit factor to 1.3 on a recent 4-week sample, small sample size though so not claiming it's proven yet. Appreciate the pushback, it's making the actual work better.

replies.author: Bryanadamz
replies.body: Read my comment properly. I've tested reversion when price is outside a standard Deviation EVERY way you can imagine. With every type of indicator and filter, even multi timeframe oversold and extended, Ive even built multiple custom indicators, pending orders, variable exits without set tp, ive built an ea that even automatically optimises parameters expontially weighted to current market structure and has built in 6 years of back test data and pauses trading when live results fall below past expectations. You can get amazing results for about a year or 2 of back test with curve fitting, but this strategy is not profitable forward testing, I've spent 3 months on this, price always reverts to the mean eventually but if it hits your stop loss 3 times then the winner means nothing

comments.author: Least_Ice_6112
comments.body: These are not results just some lines, hows the trades

replies.author: Relative-Swing-8819
replies.body: these are just signal markers, not a backtested PnL report yet. Working on compiling actual trade-by-trade results with entry/exit/SL. On the first chart, that signal was fired but price did extend further before reversing — indicator isn't 100% accuracy, it's meant to flag high-probability reversal zones, not guaranteed wins. Appreciate you pointing it out.
